thinking: Instruct checkpoint; no Thinking adapter or thought stripping

image_processing.decode: Pillow convert RGB; no EXIF transpose, alpha compositing or external resize
image_processing.status: startup budget only; not frozen as formal experimental budget

timing.preprocess_seconds: CPU image decode plus processor chat template/tokenization; excludes host-to-device transfer
timing.generate_seconds: synchronize CUDA before/after generate; includes prefill and decoding, excludes preprocessing and host-to-device transfer
timing.total_seconds: per question decode, preprocessing, device transfer, generate and text decode; excludes initial model loading and warmup
timing.cuda_peak: PyTorch current-process allocator max_memory_allocated/max_memory_reserved after per-question reset; includes resident weights; NOT nvidia-smi total device memory or all CUDA driver allocations
timing.comparison_status: two-question smoke only; not statistically validated performance

validation_status: API/source and metadata checked; GPU loading/inference/OOM not yet verified
other_family: Use a separate virtual environment and revision-specific adapter for Gemma; no Gemma compatibility claim for this pinned environment.
